title: Use RMS Map Monitor Message Panel to view AGV fault list, fault details, and locate a faulted AGV
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI Map Monitor message panel to identify faulted/disconnected AGVs, view the selected fault’s details, and use the “Locate Faulted AGV” control to bring up the corresponding location cue.
when_to_use: When you need to determine which AGVs are faulted and/or disconnected and then inspect the fault details and locate the affected AGV using the RMS Map Monitor message panel.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the RMS Map Monitor message panel checks to identify faulted/disconnected AGVs, inspect fault details, and use the locate control.

visual_references.description: RMS Map Monitor Message Panel on the right side showing: “Count of active Robots”, “Count of Robots charging”, “Drop down to show AGV faults”, “Count of AGVs disconnected”, “Inspection to view details of fault”, and “Locate Faulted AGV”.

Map Monitor Message Panel count metrics and AGV fault/disconnect panel items (active robots count, robots charging count, AGV faults dropdown, disconnected count, fault inspection, locate faulted AGV).

Robot selection overview cues (robot selection and robot details; includes robot colors such as purple for disconnected and red for fault/low battery) that can help visually confirm the located robot corresponds to the selected fault.

steps.title: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and navigate to the Map Monitor message panel
steps.purpose: Get to the panel that contains the AGV fault list, disconnected count, fault details inspection area, and the locate control.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) and navigate to the Map Monitor message panel on the right side of the interface.
steps.expected_result: The Map Monitor message panel is visible on the right side and shows the labeled items: “Count of active Robots”, “Count of Robots charging”, “Drop down to show AGV faults”, “Count of AGVs disconnected”, “Inspection to view details of fault”, and “Locate Faulted AGV”.
steps.healthy_condition: All labeled panel sections are present and readable in the Map Monitor message panel.
steps.failure_condition: The Map Monitor message panel is not visible or the labeled items are missing/unreadable.

actions.label: Verify Map Monitor message panel is present
actions.exact_action: Navigate to the Map Monitor message panel on the right side of the interface.

source_evidence.evidence: OCR lists Map Monitor Message Panel items: “Count of active Robots”, “Count of Robots charging”, “Drop down to show AGV faults”, “Count of AGVs disconnected”, “Inspection to view details of fault”, “Locate Faulted AGV”, and “E stop the system”.

steps.title: Verify the active robot and charging count metrics
steps.purpose: Confirm the panel’s core robot-count metrics are populated before drilling into faults.
steps.instruction: On the Map Monitor message panel, locate and verify the fields labeled “Count of active Robots” and “Count of Robots charging”.
steps.expected_result: Both count fields are displayed on the panel.
steps.healthy_condition: The panel shows numeric values for “Count of active Robots” and “Count of Robots charging”.
steps.failure_condition: One or both count fields are blank, missing, or not updating.

actions.label: Check count fields
actions.exact_action: Verify the panel shows the count metrics: “Count of active Robots” and “Count of Robots charging”.

source_evidence.evidence: OCR lists “Count of active Robots” and “Count of Robots charging” in the Map Monitor Message Panel.
Transcript describes “active robot count” and “robots … actively charging at the moment” and the frame OCR shows the panel items including both count fields.

steps.title: Open the AGV faults dropdown to display the fault list
steps.purpose: Reveal the list of AGV faults so you can select a specific fault entry for inspection.
steps.instruction: Use the dropdown labeled “Drop down to show AGV faults” to display the AGV fault list.
steps.expected_result: The AGV faults dropdown expands and shows fault entries.
steps.healthy_condition: Fault entries are visible in the dropdown list.
steps.failure_condition: The dropdown shows no fault entries while AGV issues are reported.

actions.label: Open AGV faults dropdown
actions.exact_action: Use the dropdown labeled “Drop down to show AGV faults” to display the AGV fault list.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the AGV faults dropdown shows no fault entries while the site reports AGV issues, escalate for deeper RMS/WCS API/DB corroboration.

source_evidence.evidence: OCR lists “Drop down to show AGV faults” as a Map Monitor Message Panel item.
Frame OCR includes “Drop down to show AGV faults” and nearby transcript explains that dropping the menu shows errors/faults.

steps.title: Check the count of AGVs disconnected
steps.purpose: Quantify disconnected AGVs as part of identifying faulted/disconnected units.
steps.instruction: On the same Map Monitor message panel, locate and check the field labeled “Count of AGVs disconnected”.
steps.expected_result: A numeric value is shown for “Count of AGVs disconnected”.
steps.healthy_condition: The “Count of AGVs disconnected” field displays a current numeric count.
steps.failure_condition: The field is blank/missing or does not reflect the expected disconnected state during an issue.

actions.label: Read disconnected count
actions.exact_action: Check the “Count of AGVs disconnected” value on the same panel.

source_evidence.evidence: OCR lists “Count of AGVs disconnected” as a Map Monitor Message Panel item.
Frame OCR includes “Count of AGVs disconnected” and transcript explains it represents AGVs that have lost communication from RMS.

steps.title: Select a fault entry and confirm fault details update
steps.purpose: Identify the specific faulted AGV and capture the fault details shown in the inspection area.
steps.instruction: In the AGV faults list, select a fault entry and use the “Inspection to view details of fault” area to confirm the fault details update for the selected entry.
steps.expected_result: The “Inspection to view details of fault” area updates to show details for the selected fault entry.
steps.healthy_condition: Fault details change when you select different fault entries.
steps.failure_condition: “Inspection to view details of fault” does not update after selecting a fault entry.

actions.label: Select fault entry
actions.exact_action: Select/inspect a fault entry using the “Inspection to view details of fault” area and confirm the fault details update.

stop_or_escalate_if: If “Inspection to view details of fault” does not update after selecting a fault entry, escalate for UI/API data issues.

source_evidence.evidence: OCR lists “Inspection to view details of fault” and “Drop down to show AGV faults” within the Map Monitor Message Panel.

steps.title: Locate the faulted AGV using the “Locate Faulted AGV” control
steps.purpose: Bring up the map/location cue for the selected fault so you can identify where the faulted AGV is.
steps.instruction: Use “Locate Faulted AGV” to bring up the faulted AGV location cue (e.g., map highlight/selection) and confirm the located AGV corresponds to the selected fault.
steps.expected_result: A location cue appears for the faulted AGV after using “Locate Faulted AGV”, and it corresponds to the selected fault entry.
steps.healthy_condition: The map/location cue highlights/selects the AGV associated with the selected fault.
steps.failure_condition: The location cue does not correspond to the selected faulted AGV.

actions.label: Locate faulted AGV
actions.exact_action: Use “Locate Faulted AGV” to bring up the faulted AGV location cue and confirm the located AGV corresponds to the selected fault.

source_evidence.evidence: OCR lists “Locate Faulted AGV” as a Map Monitor Message Panel item.
Robot selection overview describes robot colors as cues (e.g., purple = robot disconnected; red = fault/low battery), which can be used to visually confirm the located robot state.

success_criteria: The Map Monitor message panel shows “Count of active Robots” and “Count of Robots charging”.
The “Drop down to show AGV faults” displays fault entries.
Selecting a fault entry updates the “Inspection to view details of fault” area.
Using “Locate Faulted AGV” produces a location cue that corresponds to the selected faulted AGV.
healthy_conditions: Fault entries are present in the AGV faults dropdown when faults exist.
Fault details update immediately after selecting a fault entry.
The locate control highlights/selects the AGV associated with the selected fault.
failure_conditions: AGV faults dropdown shows no fault entries while AGV issues are reported.
Fault details do not update after selecting a fault entry.
Locate Faulted AGV location cue does not correspond to the selected fault.
escalation_guidance: If the AGV faults dropdown shows no fault entries while the site reports AGV issues, escalate for deeper RMS/WCS API/DB corroboration.
If “Inspection to view details of fault” does not update after selecting a fault entry, escalate for UI/API data issues.
